sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots and 97 October 2–3 channel briefs screened, with selected briefs read in full.

Signed-in @ShizzyUnchained X research included general Bittensor/TAO discovery, reward/launch watch searches and the full SN64 result thread. 192 associated public account candidates sampled and 181 unique current post records screened; these include commentators and quoted accounts, not only official teams.
178 repository paths scanned. 22 selected commit records inspected, together with current release assets, SN78 public status, SN120 release documents and dashboard, SN105 portal and SN122 docs.
Signed-in AlphaGap 119-subnet leaderboard, SubnetRadar news and Moments, TAO Daily, TAO Media and partner sources reviewed. Market snapshot and current emission leaders checked separately.
September 26–October 2 editions reviewed for duplicate stories, unresolved incidents and missed material announcements. Code, forecasts, launches, weights and individual payments were distinguished.
YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked. New October 2 members upload ChgsHOGC1hM has verified member restriction and 526-second player duration; latest public upload and SN49 replay remain unchanged.
accessGaps: Research cutoff 2026-10-03T18:07:32.413Z; overlap includes October 2 announcements after the previous cutoff. Associated-account samples and focused signed-in X searches are not exhaustive SN-number/name searches, and no Grok scan is claimed.

12 repository paths returned errors and 9 public account candidates yielded no usable posts. SN79 release and guessed SN46 miner repository paths returned 404; those releases are not independently verified.

Channel briefs are AI-generated discovery summaries. Team-attributed statements remain developing when the original speaker or live activation was not independently checked. Member-only allegations do not become findings.

SN120 reward-vector readback is reported in public operator documentation; this scan checked the documents and current dashboard, not a full independent on-chain recipient reconstruction or wallet payments. SN64 cost and benchmark comparisons are team-reported and not reproduced.

SN78 API still says rewards inactive. AP-hosted press release returned 403; the official press link and secondary recap were read, but syndicated press exposure is not independent customer verification or proof of shipped glasses.
SN118 reward restart, SN46 proof recovery, SN54 recovery and SN111 proposed 90% burn retain activation or payment gaps. SN22 scoring bottleneck and SN44 reward issue are not independently closed.

No completed SN104 security-track mainnet launch, SN124 Sentinel release, unrestricted SN94 mining or SN114 sandbox rerun was verified. SN108 now targets October 5; SN65 TPN-005 remains in final diligence. SN55 display repair does not close its prior scoring investigation.

SN82 current identity remains unverified after re-registration; its flagged seven-day return is not attributed to a former project. SN26 identity discrepancies remain unresolved. SN113 ownership-transfer reports lack verified team identity and a matched chain transfer.

decisions.reason: The 130.289312% seven-day alpha/TAO move spans the tracked deregistration/re-registration period. Current project identity and a fresh primary catalyst are unverified, so the return is not attributed to the former project or promoted as a new launch.

editorialDecisions: SN64 earns four stars for the primary stopped-run report, specific benchmark comparisons and public preliminary code. The 576B checkpoint comparison is not a completed 973B-token run. The HF card still calls the run ongoing, superseded for run status by the dated October 3 founder statement. Gradient instability, late-node discards, lackluster reasoning and future EDA tests are retained. No independent cost/benchmark reproduction or production-chat claim.

SN120 public release reports a finalized/revealed vector at block 9203767 for 19 miners and 42 audited task batches. Dashboard visibly shows 20/32 solved and a finalized epoch. This scan has not independently reconstructed the vector or wallet receipts. Latest matched 22/32 to 20/32 is a decline, not a learning gain. Historical nonpayable epochs remain ineligible. Sensitive operator hosts, credential locations and private operational details are omitted.

SN15 scheduled Race 11 is updated for the reported validator pause. Runtime-contract claim/delivery validation is verified code. The reported 100% burn and promised reset are secondary and not confirmed payouts. No named miner is accused of exploiting ORO. SN118 code recovery is verified, but unburn/reward propagation remains a secondary operational report, not a reconciled chain all-clear.

SN111 90% burn is a prospective next-week report, not current activation. The brief explicitly lacks confirmed team messages; TAOli corroborates the report secondarily but is not a substitute for primary identity. No guaranteed profitability, alpha price stabilization or customer-capacity claim. Burn refers to the share of miner emissions, not all network emissions or a token sale.

SN78 API recorded 203 accepted, open admission, intake_no_weight, rewards_active false and chain_submission_authorized false at 17:58 UTC. This overrides any implication that C5 enrollment already pays. Direct model uploads are verified new code. Roster/evaluation targets are not completion. Press distribution is not independent adoption evidence; no shipped SignVision or orders claimed.

SN105 live browser page limits bug reports to registered orchestrators. A secondary claim that anybody can report was corrected against the loaded primary page. Confirmed bugs may qualify for rewards, not every report. No wallet connected, message signed or report submitted. SN122 documentation is live; dashboard and post-beta buybacks remain future plans.

SN74 release v0.6.9 has actual binaries and scoped RTX5090 Qwen3.8 UD benchmarks. Quantization has 1.2% perplexity cost and different concurrency outcomes; no universal speed guarantee. Latest stale-token fallback is verified code beyond the release. SN117 v0.2.3 replaces approval catch-all with automatic-attestation/readiness checks, not permission to bypass admission.

SN8 selectable 3%/5% drawdown thresholds are immutable at creation; code merge does not prove all existing accounts changed or a live customer used it. SN14 retained authenticated reward inputs expire after twelve hours and fall back to burn; commit explicitly performed no live writes. SN81 current science count is 13,547 and 2% tolerance, superseding the initial 14,145/1% draft, with a dormant profile and no live registry activation.

SN79 proportional pay was covered September29. The new secondary item is versioned v0.6.2 mainnet claim plus pending v0.6.3; public repository/release access returned404. Liquidity/volume are reported figures, not independently confirmed. SN54 recovery is a late October2 follow-up and does not activate gated UAV rewards; primary transaction-buy-alpha design is not an executed ledger.

SN10 campaign sunset does not cancel the SN53 production partnership. SN46 proof recovery and $80 epoch reward remain secondary reports. SN60 Opus5.5 round and possible extension are team-attributed secondary claims; no independent reproduction or accusation of prior agents.

SN108 now targets MondayOctober5 rather than Oct2–3. SN121 SBC30 targets October5–6, not live. SN80 fee0.5TAO/private entries are proposals. SN109 ready MVP and SN13 talks are not launch/partnership completion. SN114 JEV feature remains prospective and sandbox rerun unconfirmed.

SN97 real Git-history simulator fix is verified; wrong-strike removal/requeues remain member-only unconfirmed. SN71 related-news evidence extraction fix is new, but upstream API incident not closed. SN11 single missing-reward investigation not generalized to all miners. SN44 demo/pipeline work does not resolve old zero-score or Person incidents; October2 break-even/burn not duplicated.

Current top12 emission recipients: SN51,SN64,SN4,SN120,SN107,SN44,SN53,SN8,SN80,SN3,SN15,SN38. SN64,SN120,SN44,SN8,SN80,SN15 covered. SN51 deadGPU handling alreadyOct2; SN4 B300/cloud alreadycovered; SN107 synthetic variant Q&A not a fresh launch or demonstrated discrepancy; SN53 production alreadyOct2; SN3 community tokenizer script not a team milestone; SN38 revenue answer links existing statement and prior build timeline remains, no new revenue or training completion.

SN82 130.289312% seven-day alpha/TAO return spans previously tracked re-registration; current identity and primary catalyst unknown. No other absolute24h>=15%,7d>=75% or missing-return flags at market snapshot. AlphaGap USD moves are differently denominated and timed and were not substituted for site alpha/TAO returns.

Moments reviewed including SN96 conviction additions approximately4.5k/4.3k alpha October2 and SN17 110-alpha perpetual-to-decaying change October3. Small changes are below a material standalone news threshold and are not sales. Seven coldkey events are retained in audit; no verified subnet-owner mapping or ownership transfer. AI smart-money labels, alleged supply percentages, wallet motives and SN51 confidence/compute claims are not findings. Existing Oct2 large lock reductions not repeated.

SN113 member-only slot-handover report excluded without identified team statement or matched ownership transfer. SN20/SN81 self-mining, SN56 undeclared-data DQ, SN95 scam-profit/owner-exit and SN125 private-code claims are not verified allegations. SN55 old UI fix is not closure of scoring investigation. SN61 browser recovery does not resolve Kraken/KYC/buybacks. SN124 Sentinel and SN94 unrestricted mining remain unconfirmed.

SN50 volatility scoring was already October 1. SN9 SDK is a preview targeting 2026, not a new complete release. SN65 TPN005 is in final diligence, SN37 Proba remains delayed, SN75 desktop 0.6.6 was already covered October 2, and SN96 Gleipnir/operation descriptions do not establish newly verified production activation. Summit sponsor/thank-you posts and reposted interviews add no new launch. SN49 tournament-rule follow-up is newly covered from the October 2 brief: current rankings reportedly stand while next-round checks will tighten. The September 30 environment announcement did not cover these rules. Individual allegations and payout settlement were not independently audited. The SN49 replay remains available. No unrelated StonkFun, Chainlink, Robinhood token pairs or general-crypto stories.
